methodology: ATLAS's own initial product taxonomy for grouping Vietnamese listed companies by primary business line. It is NOT an official classification of HOSE, HNX, the State Securities Commission or any index provider, and does not map 1:1 to ICB, GICS or VSIC. Companies are assigned by their primary revenue-generating activity as stated in their own disclosures; every assignment must carry evidence. Codes are stable and never reused; names and descriptions may change in later versions.
